title: Monitoring Under Capability Uplift: Do Current Monitors Still Work When Agents Become More Capable?
original_idea: Evaluate the same LLM monitor on SHADE-Arena sabotage attempts from agents of different capability tiers (GPT-4o-mini, GPT-4o, Claude-3-sonnet). Measure whether detection AUC decreases as agent capability increases. Investigate monitor-agent capability scaling.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Excellent theory: if monitoring degrades with agent capability, current safety guarantees erode over time. This directly addresses one of the most important questions in AI safety scaling. Clear, falsifiable, safety-critical prediction.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires API access to multiple model tiers and running SHADE-Arena with different agents. Setting up SHADE-Arena runs with different models needs some infrastructure knowledge. Medium compute for multiple model runs. Feasible in 30hrs with guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-defined: 3 agent tiers, one monitor, measure AUC for each. Clear deliverable (capability scaling curve). Minor ambiguity in controlling for task difficulty across models.
